issues_detected.title: Mold Growth on Roof Sheathing
issues_detected.description: The roof sheathing shows significant mold growth, which is indicative of moisture issues in the attic space.
issues_detected.recommendation: Investigate and address the source of moisture. Improve attic ventilation and consider professional mold remediation.

analysis.overall_assessment: The attic shows signs of mold growth, suggesting moisture problems that need immediate attention.
